newsitem.title: TURKEY: Missile hits Turk military hostel, one injured.
newsitem.headline: Missile hits Turk military hostel, one injured.

text.p: A missile slammed into a military hostel in the centre of Istanbul on Monday, injuring one woman and causing slight damage, state-run Anatolian news agency reported.

It said an officer's wife had been injured in the attack at around 8 a.m. (0500 GMT) when a missile hit the 13th floor of the building, smashing windows. She was taken to a military hospital for treatment.
Istanbul police chief, Ramazan Er, said he expected arrests soon. "Our colleagues are working on it," he said.
Anatolian said that urban guerrillas of the far-left Revolutionary People's Liberation Party-Front (DHKP-C) had claimed responsibility for the attack.
The weapon, shown on TV news reports, appeared to have been a disposable shoulder-held missile launcher similar to one used in an attack on Istanbul police headquarters last month.
The DHKP-C also claimed responsibility for that attack.
